about: As 158-edited-source-gets-pointer up to the flag findings, which here say neither of u6's flags was asked for. `act` at judged undoes u6 after u7's pointer is on the edited line: undo finds the line by u6's `after` with the pointer added and puts u6's `before` back, pointer kept for the moment. u7's source line is the line u6's edit changed, so u7 is undone too (CONTRACT.md 5.3 item 13): its pointer comes off, found by its source text now that u6 no longer counts, and its copy leaves idea-mara-lighthouse. Both notes read as they did at run start, and undo misses nothing. The second Edit guard check raises nothing. At `close`, both units are undone, so the line, the copy, and the comment in its piece stay off the handled list, and the next run hands the piece back. The log lists both under Units undone: u6 with the flag that wasn't asked for, u7 because the run's edit to its line was undone.
spec: CONTRACT.md 5.3 items 10 (an edit's after carrying a pointer), 13; 5.5 items 5, 6; 5.6 items 3, 6
readings: u7's reason is saved as {"why": "edit-undone", "unit": "b1-u6"} in undone-why.json; the first reason saved for a unit stands.
u7 is undone right after u6, in the same `act`, so `act`'s next_check covers both.

Retired 2026-10-23 for Run manager Milestone 16 (plan-run-manager.md 06 item 14, reading 5): u6 is approved and a comment started it, so its flags now stand and never reach the not-asked verdict this case turns on. Case 166 covers the same undo through a chained line.
